s: At their best, a robo-advisor can build you a broadly diversified investment portfolio to meet your long-term needs. If you want the account to be primarily in cash or a basic savings account, then two of the leading robo-advisors — Wealthfront and Betterment — offer that option as well. Risks: The risks of a robo-advisor depend largely on your investments. If you buy mainly stock funds because you have a high risk tolerance, you can expect more volatility than if you buy bonds or hold cash in a savings account.
